mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(post_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM posts WHERE SUBSTR(post_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET content = #{content}, is_public = #{isPublic}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, fi.s3_url AS profileImageUrl, p.content, DECODE(p.is_public, 'Y', 1, 0) AS isPublic, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN file_info fi ON u.file_id = fi.file_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.is_active = 'Y'
SELECT pi.file_id AS fileId, fi.s3_url AS url FROM post_images pi INNER JOIN file_info fi ON pi.file_id = fi.file_id WHERE pi.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY pi.created_at

SELECT c.clothes_id AS clothesId, c.name, c.brand, c.price, fi.s3_url AS imageUrl FROM post_clothes pc INNER JOIN clothes c ON pc.clothes_id = c.clothes_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT ci.clothes_id, ci.file_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.clothes_id ORDER BY ci.created_at) AS rn FROM clothes_images ci ) ci ON ci.clothes_id = c.clothes_id AND ci.rn = 1 INNER JOIN file_info fi ON ci.file_id = fi.file_id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, i.s3_url AS imageUrl, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, fi.s3_url as profileImageUrl, p.content, p.like_count AS likeCount, DECODE(l.target_id, NULL, 0, 1) AS isLiked, c.categoryCodes AS categoryCodesStr FROM posts p INNER JOIN ( SELECT pi.post_id, fi.s3_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.post_id ORDER BY pi.created_at) AS rn FROM post_images pi INNER JOIN file_info fi ON pi.file_id = fi.file_id ) i ON p.post_id = i.post_id AND i.rn = 1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT pc.post_id, LISTAGG(DISTINCT c.category_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.category_code) AS categoryCodes FROM post_clothes pc INNER JOIN clothes c ON pc.clothes_id = c.clothes_id GROUP BY pc.post_id ) c ON p.post_id = c.post_id INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN file_info fi ON u.file_id = fi.file_id LEFT OUTER JOIN likes l ON p.post_id = l.target_id AND l.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.is_active = 'Y' AND p.is_public = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, i.s3_url AS imageUrl FROM posts p INNER JOIN ( SELECT pi.post_id, f.s3_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.post_id ORDER BY pi.created_at) AS rowrum FROM post_images pi INNER JOIN file_info f ON pi.file_id = f.file_id ) i ON p.post_id = i.post_id AND i.rowrum = 1 WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_active = 'Y'
AND p.is_public = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
